newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese fund investment rises 23 pct in H1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese fund investment rises 23 pct in H1 1997.

text.p: Domestic financial market and property assets under management by Portuguese investment funds rose 22.5 percent in the first six months of 1997 to 3.81 trillion escudos ($20.7 billion), the Fund Management Association (APFIN) said.
Financial market funds grew 26 percent to 3.34 trillion escudos. Investment in the domestic share market rose 179 percent and in foreign shares by 131 percent.
Compared with the previous month, domestic share market investment was up 33 percent in June at 153.5 billion escudos.
Money market funds fell 35 percent to 4.70 trillion escudos in June, indexed bond funds fell 36 percent to 806 billion.
